films.title: Johnny Gaddaar
films.overview: Five men get involved in a drug deal set up by a corrupt police officer, but the plan goes awry when the youngest member decides to steal the money.

films.title: Agent Vinod
films.overview: Agent Vinod sets out on a secret mission to find the reason behind the death of Rajan, his colleague. Terror strikes when he unfolds an even bigger conspiracy.

films.title: Ek Hasina Thi
films.overview: A woman falls for a charming and mysterious businessman. The whirlwind romance turns sour when she is framed for his underworld crimes. Now, finally out of prison she is ready for sweet revenge.

films.title: Merry Christmas
films.overview: A Christmas Eve encounter between two enigmatic strangers sparks a poignant connection - but a dark turn of events threatens to expose their murky past.

films.title: Badlapur
films.overview: After his wife and son are killed, a young man finds out the man behind the murder and fights against him, along committing some big mistakes.

films.title: Andhadhun
films.overview: A series of mysterious events changes the life of a blind pianist who now must report a crime that was actually never witnessed by him.
